newsitem.title: USA: Daschle suggests stopgap 1997 U.S. money bill.
newsitem.headline: Daschle suggests stopgap 1997 U.S. money bill.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle, D-South Dakota, said Friday that time constraints may force Congress to act on a short-term fiscal 1997 government spending bill prior to Tuesday's start of the new fiscal year.

Speaking to reporters, Daschle identified several difficult issues that remain to be ironed out. including immigration reform, banking regulatory rules changes, protection for physician communications with patients and a ban on gun ownership by convicted spouse abusers.
